ResearchProjectDef.label: spearfishing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work metal into better gear for divers: a pole spear with a forged steel point, a glass mask that lets a diver see fish clearly, and a leather wetsuit for colder water. A snorkel makes time in the sea more relaxing. It is also the first step toward better diving gear, and with fish stock management on it opens sea floor restoration, the artificial reef and the hatchery.
